steps.what: Read the current lesson goal and existing individual access or support needs before instruction
inputs: existing pupil access and support information

steps.what: Instruct students using phonetics, multisensory techniques or repetition adapted to their actual needs and responses

tasks.design: Link the current lesson and existing access information in {LMS} and {DOCS}. The teacher retains all instruction and responsive adaptation using the classroom's physical learning aids {OTHER}; only a small immediate reference lookup changes.
tasks.previous_blocker: The immediate lesson and pupil support references may require separate openings.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing lesson links can remove repeated navigation without producing an instructional decision.
tasks.still_hard: Children's responses, accessibility, attention and learning needs require live teacher judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher observes and adapts the interaction to the individual child.

ambition.what: Responsive instruction remains the teacher's work.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: linked existing lesson references can reduce navigation but cannot replace live special-education instruction.

assumptions: Boundary is actual instruction and the immediate reference reading it uses. Course-material creation and separately required pupil record entries are separate tasks, both modeled elsewhere in this prompt; do not invent a post-lesson note here.

The teacher's existing lesson plan supplies goal, activity and material reference; the existing pupil support record supplies agreed access requirements and date. s1 retains reading/checking and manual retrieval when absent. Those plans are actually produced in preparation work, not a free new dataset.
Test native lesson links first. s1 removes 1 of 5 units of repeated opening, retaining 4 for reading; all 95 live-instruction units remain. These are unmeasured estimates, not a time-share prior.

No model, automatic pupil score, emotion inference, recording or external send is proposed. Upkeep covers link repair beyond ordinary reading. {OTHER} means physical classroom learning and accessibility aids, not a new sensor system.
unknowns: Whether lesson references are already linked
research_questions: Observe actual instruction and immediate reference reading without assigning course preparation or record writing to it.

already_counted.description: Immediate reference reading and all live instruction remain in s1-s2.

incremental.description: Maintain and repair the existing lesson/support reference links beyond normal lesson reading.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=4+95=99. Gross 1 less 0.5 upkeep gives net 0.5. Conservative case: a changed support reference retains 4.5 of 5 lookup units; the 0.5 gain only covers upkeep. Instruction is unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read the applicable curriculum guidelines and actual course requirements
Choose course objectives and access requirements suited to the actual students and curriculum
inputs: existing pupil learning and access information

steps.what: Prepare the course outline and draft learning materials from the teacher-selected objectives
outputs: draft course outline and learning materials

loop.purpose: Draft outline wording and candidate activities within teacher-selected objectives and access constraints.
loop.input: Selected objectives, supplied curriculum references and current teacher preparation notes.
loop.output: Draft outline and materials with an objective reference for each activity.
loop.check: Teacher checks every objective mapping, factual claim, activity instruction, developmental fit and access requirement; no diagnostic or ability label may be invented.
loop.stop: Unmapped objectives, inaccessible content or unsupported assumptions stop for teacher rewrite after at most two drafts.
loop.why_not_simpler: A template alone does not compose varied activity wording; use existing materials unchanged whenever suitable.

steps.what: Verify the complete objectives, outline and materials against curriculum and actual pupil access needs
inputs: draft course outline and learning materials

steps.what: Prepare the actual printed and physical learning materials required by the checked course outline
Save the checked course outline and materials in the existing teacher preparation file

tasks.design: Use the existing {DOCS} or {LMS} template and curriculum codes first, with a bounded loop only for drafting varied outline and activity wording. The teacher chooses the objectives, corrects the drafts, checks the full materials and prepares the actual physical aids {OTHER}; no pupil decision or publication is automated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Rewriting outlines and activity instructions from the same curriculum references can be repetitive.
tasks.enabler_now: Templates and bounded drafting can organize supplied preparation notes with explicit objective references.
tasks.still_hard: Developmental fit, accessibility and usable multisensory materials need teacher judgement and physical preparation.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher knows the children and can reject a superficially plausible activity that will not work for them.

ambition.what: Prepare the same curriculum materials with less first-draft wording work.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a source-bound drafting loop can propose outlines and activity wording, while teacher-selected goals, access checks and physical preparation remain necessary.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual objective selection, outline/material writing, complete checks and the physical preparation the material requires. It does not invent a separate report, parent send or school-wide publication.

The actual curriculum publisher supplies goal code, text, level, version and requirements. s1 counts reading and source capture. The teacher selects objectives and access needs in s2; s3 retains existing preparation-note capture and rewrite effort. No new structured pupil profile is assumed.

Try existing materials, native templates and fixed objective-code lists first. Only repeated new draft wording in s3 changes, retaining 18 of 40 units for capture and correction; s4 retains 19 units for full curriculum/meaning/access checks, and s5 retains all physical printing/tactile assembly. {OTHER} means classroom printing and physical learning aids.

Additional prompt/source packaging and failed-draft repair beyond retained writing are counted below. All stated shares are unmeasured workflow estimates, not borrowed planning trial results or prompt priors.

s6 is an ordinary same-system author save at the minimum share, fully retained and ungated. The preparation file is used for actual teaching. Any later formal external release needs its own real action and authority.
Pupil-data access and applicable national school participation rules must be checked; no pupil evaluation, emotion inference or session recording is proposed.
unknowns: Actual existing materials and preparation workflow
Required accessibility checks and physical aids
Whether drafting still saves time after correction
research_questions: Trace a real course outline from curriculum to classroom-ready materials.
Test an inaccessible activity and a wrong objective mapping, retaining teacher rewrite and physical preparation.

already_counted.description: Curriculum reading, objective selection, drafting correction, full material checks, physical preparation and ordinary persistence remain in s1-s6.

incremental.description: Additional source/prompt packaging, curriculum/template upkeep and failed-draft repair beyond retained corrections.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=10+20+18+19+10+1=78. Gross 22 minus 4 additional work gives net 18. Conservative case: unfamiliar sensory-access requirements make most proposed activities unusable, retaining 33 of 40 draft units. Seven gross units less 4 additional work gives 3; all goal selection, complete checking and physical preparation remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Assess actual students' learning and access needs from observation and current support information
Retrieve the existing support approaches and actual specialist guidance relevant to those student needs
inputs: existing support approaches and specialist guidance

steps.what: Develop and write the actual teaching strategy, choosing adaptations and checking their suitability for the student

loop.purpose: Organize teacher-supplied strategy notes into the existing planning headings, without selecting a disability intervention.
loop.input: Teacher's actual needs assessment, supplied references and current planning notes.
loop.output: Draft wording of the teacher's proposed adaptations with source references.
loop.check: Teacher checks every proposed adaptation, attribution and access claim against actual student needs and specialist guidance; unsupported recommendations are removed.
loop.stop: Unsupported strategies or conflicting guidance stop for manual planning and appropriate specialist clarification.
loop.why_not_simpler: Variable free-text planning notes need organization; use a fixed template alone where adequate.

steps.what: Implement the selected strategies with students and adapt them to actual responses

tasks.design: Link actual support guidance in {DOCS}, then use a bounded draft only to organize the teacher's own strategy-planning notes. Need assessment, strategy choice, full suitability checks and responsive classroom implementation with physical learning aids {OTHER} remain human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant support guidance can be scattered and existing strategy notes need repeated organization.
tasks.enabler_now: Native references and bounded text organization can address those operations without choosing interventions.
tasks.still_hard: A useful strategy depends on the individual child, specialist context and observed response.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher notices whether an adaptation works and changes it responsibly for the child.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: linked guidance and source-bound organization of teacher notes can support strategy planning, but need assessment and intervention choice remain professional judgement.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual needs assessment, guidance reading, strategy planning and implementation. No automatic diagnosis, ability score, emotion inference or extra pupil report is added.

The current teacher/support team supplies existing observations and support references; s1 counts actual observation and source reading, s2 guidance retrieval/checking, and s3 the teacher's real planning-note capture, strategy choice, full meaning checks and manual repair. {OTHER} means physical classroom learning aids and observation, not sensors.

Test native guidance links and strategy templates first. s2 removes 3 of 15 units of repeated navigation and retains 12 for reading. s3 retains 20 of 25 units for capture, selection and checking, removing only repeated wording organization. Current ordinary same-system working saves stay within that retained time, ungated and with no benefit.

Any new source packaging, extra dictation or failed-draft repair beyond retained planning is additional work budgeted below. No clean student profile or new specialist report is supplied for free. Shares are unmeasured task-specific estimates.

Actual statutory support-plan approval or external disclosure, where part of another workflow, needs its own final-version action; an internal teaching strategy is not assigned a fictional self-approval.
unknowns: Which planning content already has structured fields
Whether draft organization survives full suitability checks
research_questions: Observe a real adaptation from need assessment through classroom response.
Test conflicting specialist guidance and an unsuitable draft adaptation without letting the model choose the strategy.

already_counted.description: Needs assessment, source reading, teacher strategy selection and checking, and all implementation remain in s1-s4.

incremental.description: Additional source packaging or dictation, reference upkeep and failed-draft repair beyond retained teacher planning.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=25+12+20+35=92. Gross 8 less 3 additional work gives net 5. Conservative case: a rare access need requires 14 of 15 guidance units and extensive individualized strategy wording retains 23 of 25 planning units. The 3 gross units just cover upkeep, while need assessment and implementation remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Capture and check the actual student observations, attendance or learning information required in the existing records
Assemble the required existing student fields into the current working record sections
inputs: existing pupil identifier and record structure

steps.what: Verify student record identity, dates, source completeness and discrepancies against actual requirements
outputs: verified student record fields and unresolved discrepancies

steps.what: Write and check the actual required student record comments from the teacher's dated observations
inputs: verified student record fields and unresolved discrepancies

loop.purpose: Organize existing teacher observations into the required narrative record fields.
loop.input: Dated teacher observations, verified fields and actual record headings.
loop.output: Draft record comments with observation references and unresolved gaps explicit.
loop.check: Teacher checks every factual and learning statement, date and attribution; no diagnostic labels, scores or support needs may be inferred.
loop.stop: Unsupported statements or missing sources stop for manual correction; no more than two drafts.
loop.why_not_simpler: Only varied narrative fields need text organization; fixed fields use native copying and no model.

steps.what: Save the checked student record in its existing working file

tasks.design: Use native field reuse between the existing pupil records system {OTHER} and {LMS}; only narrative comments need a bounded draft from actual dated teacher notes. Keep observation capture, complete record checks, missing-data resolution and comment verification with the teacher; ordinary working saves remain ungated.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same already captured pupil fields may be copied into multiple working record sections, while narrative observations need organization.
tasks.enabler_now: Native views, mapped fields and bounded comment drafting can avoid that repeated assembly.
tasks.still_hard: Record completeness, ambiguous observations and pupil-specific meaning need the teacher and authoritative sources.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher knows what was actually observed and avoids turning incomplete evidence into a label.

ambition.what: Maintain the same required student records with less duplicate assembly.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: existing pupil fields can be reused deterministically and narrative drafts can be checked against teacher notes, without inferring diagnoses or deciding pupil outcomes.

assumptions: {OTHER} is the actual pupil records system. Boundary is maintaining the existing working student record, not final statutory filing, publishing a report to parents or committing a consequential pupil decision. Any such actual action needs its own final-version release step.

The teacher produces pupil ID, observation date, author, observation text, source reference and relevant recorded measure in s1. Existing attendance/learning systems supply their actual dated entries. s1 counts observation capture and checking; s3 counts completeness checks, manual missing-source lookup and discrepancy repair. No new clean observation feed is assumed.

Test native record views and field reuse first. s2 counts only today's real duplicate field copying and section assembly; existing automatic replication and runtime earn no new saving. If no duplicate entry exists, that part of the gain is zero. s2 changes only the working record, not an external send or formal filing.

s4 retains 14.25 of 19 units for actual note capture, full meaning checks and manual repair. Additional source packaging, failed field transfer and draft repair beyond those checks are counted below. Shares are unmeasured design estimates.

The record is required and actually read for ongoing pupil support; no trailing report nobody uses is added. s5 is ordinary same-system persistence at the minimum share, fully retained and without a self-approval stage or saving.

Pupil-data access, applicable national school participation arrangements and actual record requirements must be confirmed before use. No automated assessment, emotion inference or recording is proposed.
unknowns: Actual duplicate fields and native reuse
Required narrative fields and source availability
research_questions: Trace each current record field to its actual producer and identify genuine duplicate manual entry.
Test a wrong pupil identifier, missing observation date and unsupported narrative claim; retain manual repair without filing an unverified record.

already_counted.description: Actual observation capture, complete record checking, narrative capture/correction and ordinary persistence remain in s1, s3, s4 and s5.

incremental.description: Maintain field mappings and record headings, package sources and repair failed transfers/drafts beyond retained case checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=25+0+25+14.25+1=65.25. Gross 34.75 less 4 additional work gives net 30.75. Conservative case: inconsistent identifiers and record sections leave 24 of 30 assembly units manual, and nuanced comments retain 17 of 19 writing units. Eight gross units less 4 upkeep gives 4; actual observation capture and completeness checking stay fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The teacher retains live instruction, strategy decisions and actual observations, while preparation drafts and genuine duplicate record assembly may take less time.
skills_to_grow: Check objective mappings and material accessibility
Trace pupil record fields to dated observations
Distinguish working record saves from formal releases
role.ambitious_version: Prepare accessible materials and maintain source-linked pupil records without allowing a drafting tool to decide a child's needs or outcomes.
